notes: Inter-governmental research fellowship run by OIC-COMSTECH. Official page (comstech.org/comstech-fellowships-for-research-and-trainings-in-human) states host institutions are 'Various OIC R&D and Higher Education Institutions' drawn from the CCoE member list (dozens of institutions across OIC states, e.g. ICCBS Karachi, COMSATS, LUMS, Kazan Federal University); no specific host institution or supervising professor is attached to this call. Fellows apply via a central COMSTECH form and host placement is assigned after selection. National/inter-governmental scheme with no attached institution, so not_applicable per research guidance.

Inter-governmental research fellowship run by OIC-COMSTECH for virology/vaccine technologies. Official page (comstech.org/comstech-fellowship) states: 'Hosting Country: Various higher education institutions in OIC Member states including Pakistan' and applications go to COMSTECH HQ for joint review by 'an expert committee of the COMSTECH and Host institutions'. No specific host centre of excellence or named supervising professor is attached to this call. National/inter-governmental scheme with no attached institution, so not_applicable per research guidance.

Inter-governmental research fellowship run by OIC-COMSTECH for women scientists from OIC least developed countries. Official page (comstech.org/comstech-research-fellowships-for-women-scientists-ldc-oic) states hosting is at 'Designated centers of excellence in OIC member states' with host institutions providing 'subsistence supervision, and mentor local trainings', but the call names no specific host institution or supervising professor; host is drawn from the CCoE member list after selection. National/inter-governmental scheme with no attached institution, so not_applicable per research guidance.

Regional scholarship programme of the East African Community and Germany, implemented by IUCEA (iucea.org/two-year-funded-masters-scholarships-for-cohort-4). It funds taught Master's study at ~22 partner universities across EAC Partner States (e.g. Chuka, Strathmore, University of Rwanda, Sokoine, University of Dar es Salaam). The call lists eligible programmes and universities but names no supervising professors or coordinators; admission is handled directly by each university and scholarship award by IUCEA. Regional/government scheme with no attached institution, so not_applicable per research guidance.

Inter-governmental research fellowship run by OIC-COMSTECH for researchers from OIC least developed countries. Official page (comstech.org/comstech-research-fellowships-for-least-developed-countries-2) states: 'Hosting Country: Various R &D and higher education institutions of OIC' and applications are submitted to COMSTECH HQ for joint review with host institutions. The call names no specific host institution or supervising professor; host is drawn from the CCoE member list after selection. National/inter-governmental scheme with no attached institution, so not_applicable per research guidance.

Nigerian federal government agency scheme (Petroleum Technology Development Fund). Official guidelines page (scholarship.ptdf.gov.ng/guidelines) covers Undergraduate, Master's and PhD awards across Nigerian public universities with a published list of sponsored courses; applicants must already hold admission into any public university and apply through the PTDF Scholarship Management Portal. No institution, department or supervising professor is attached to the scheme; PhD applicants submit their own research proposals. Government scheme with no attached institution, so not_applicable per research guidance.

Bilateral government scholarship between the Kingdom of Morocco and the Government of Rwanda, published by Rwanda's Higher Education Council (hec.gov.rw PDF: 'the Kingdom of Morocco has offered to the Government of Rwanda scholarships at Diploma, Bachelors, Masters and PhD level commencing in academic year 2026/2027 taught in French from Moroccan public training institutions/universities'). Applications are submitted via the HEC MIS system (hecmis.hec.gov.rw). The announcement names no specific Moroccan universities or supervising professors. Bilateral government scheme with no attached institution, so not_applicable per research guidance.
